title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 8
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q071_at_play
elements.title: Several factors are ___ here, including rising costs and falling demand.

elements.name: q072_come_at_a_cost
elements.title: The new system saves time, but the convenience comes ___: it uses more energy.

elements.name: q073_preparednes
elements.title: Weekly drills improved the team's ___ for an emergency.

elements.name: q074_double_whammy
elements.title: The shop lost power and its freezer failed on the same day. The owner described it as a ___.

elements.name: q075_hanging_over
elements.title: The unresolved threat of closure is still ___ the library and worrying its staff.

elements.name: q076_overwhelming_consensus
elements.title: Nearly every member agreed on the recommendation, producing an ___.

elements.name: q077_behind_the_curve
elements.title: Other schools updated their systems years ago, but this one has fallen ___ and still uses old equipment.

elements.name: q078_nothing_s_off_the_table
elements.title: “Nothing's off the table yet.” What does this mean during a discussion?
choices: A final decision has already been made.
Every option is still being considered.
The group has stopped accepting ideas.
Certain options have been rejected permanently.
elements.correctAnswer: Every option is still being considered.

elements.name: q079_erupt
elements.title: As the winner was announced, celebrations began to ___ all over town without warning.

elements.name: q080_undetected
elements.title: The error went ___ for months because nobody examined the records closely.
